# TPC-Havoc Q12_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    l.l_shipmode,
    sum(case
        when o.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' or o.o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'
        then 1 else 0
    end) as high_line_count,
    sum(case
        when o.o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' and o.o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH'
        then 1 else 0
    end) as low_line_count
from
    orders o
    inner join lineitem l on o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
where
    l.l_shipmode in ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    and l.l_commitdate < l.l_receiptdate
    and l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
    and l.l_receiptdate >= date '1994-01-01'
    and l.l_receiptdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
group by
    l.l_shipmode
order by
    l.l_shipmode
```
